summary: Narrowed the broad method-frontier novelty claim after finding EvoSkill's Pareto frontier/held-out skill selection; formalized a more specific context-indexed, authority-scoped, validity-gated method atlas that preserves incompatible useful methods as parallel local views and can be materialized under bounded context.

prior_art.effect: Pareto frontier of agent programs, held-out skill validation and transfer are prior art.
Validated scientific skill mining and evolving external skill libraries are prior art.
Ability-transfer evaluation of agent self-evolution is prior art/close neighbor.
Controlled evaluator evolution is prior art.

current_claim: RAKL can treat internal and external method operators as contextual method charts and evaluate them under typed context, assumption, authority and resource scopes; runtime frontier selection remains unimplemented/prospective.
must_not_claim: RAKL invented Pareto frontiers for evolved agent skills
RAKL is first to mine scientific resources into skills
RAKL has empirically realized all strengths of all external frameworks
contextual method frontier has proven empirical superiority

next_benchmark_required.falsifier: If simpler global Pareto/static selection matches RAKL on epistemic validity, transfer and cost, the extra frontier structure does not earn runtime complexity.

next_ai.positive: Freeze contextual-frontier known-answer worlds before runtime implementation; use real external operators and matched resources.
next_ai.null: If the contextual structure adds no benefit over simple global Pareto selection, retain the method atlas as explanatory theory only and do not add routing complexity.
next_ai.refuted: If a prior system is semantically equivalent to context/authority-scoped non-forced method assimilation, narrow the novelty claim and preserve the refutation.
next_ai.partial_id: If method contexts/resources cannot be normalized enough for direct comparison, preserve parallel local views or CANNOT_CHECK rather than ranking them.
next_ai.blocked: Do not activate external methods with unresolved authority/provenance/transition requirements.
next_ai.transport: If main moves before this research-only branch is fast-forwarded, inspect the intervening changes and rebuild only if the research files remain semantically non-conflicting.
